newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Aeroflot to add two CIS routes in June.
newsitem.headline: Aeroflot to add two CIS routes in June.

text.p: Russian international flagship carrier Aeroflot will begin two new regular routes from Moscow -- one to Kazakhstan and one to Ukraine -- in June, the company said in a press release on Tuesday.
Aeroflot will launch flights three times a week between Moscow and Chimkent in Kazakhstan from June 2, using Tupole Tu-154 jets.
The company will also begin regular flights from Moscow to Dnepropetrovsk in Ukraine from June 16 operating Tupolev Tu-134 jets.
Aeroflot operates scheduled flights to 12 destinations in the fomer Soviet Union and has regular services to 93 countries around the world.
The company carried 3.8 million passengers in 1996 up from 3.5 million in 1995. - Viktor Anoshkin, Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
